issues.t: Sudden loss of drive power from battery contactors (recall)
issues.sym: The car suddenly loses power to the wheels while driving, usually with warning messages on the screen.
issues.why: The high-voltage contactors, heavy-duty switches that connect the battery to the motors, can open without warning. Recall 23V110 adds a software update and replaces contactors where needed.
issues.next: If drive power cuts out, turn on your hazard lights, coast to a safe place and stop. Check your VIN for open recalls on the Lucid or NHTSA site and make sure the car has the latest software.

issues.t: Loss of drive power after an inverter fault (recall)
issues.sym: The car loses drive power with little or no warning.
issues.why: Older software (2.0.64 and earlier) did not handle a failure in the inverter power module well, which could cut drive power. Recall 23V523 is a free over-the-air software update.
issues.next: If drive power cuts out, turn on your hazard lights, coast to a safe place and stop. Check your VIN for open recalls on the Lucid or NHTSA site and make sure the car has the latest software.

issues.t: High-voltage safety circuit can cut power while driving (recall)
issues.sym: The car shuts off drive power while moving after a brief electrical glitch.
issues.why: After a communication fault, the high-voltage interlock software could open the battery contactors while driving. Recall 24V497 fixed this with an over-the-air update released in June 2024.
issues.next: If drive power cuts out, turn on your hazard lights, coast to a safe place and stop. Check your VIN for open recalls on the Lucid or NHTSA site and make sure the car has the latest software.

issues.t: Loss of drive power with adaptive cruise on (recall)
issues.sym: While using adaptive cruise control, the car suddenly loses drive power.
issues.why: Software versions 2.1.2 through 2.1.26 could set a fault while adaptive cruise was on. Recall 24V076 is covered by an over-the-air update released in October 2023.
issues.next: If it happens while you're driving: turn on your hazard lights, hold the wheel firmly and steer to a safe spot off the road. Steering and brakes can feel much heavier when the engine or power cuts out, so press the brake harder than normal. Have it checked before you drive it again. Make sure your car has installed all updates (check the software version in Settings). Until then, avoid adaptive cruise and contact Lucid.

issues.t: Rear drive unit wiring harness too short, power loss (recall)
issues.sym: The car may lose power to the rear drive motor while driving.
issues.why: On Air Pure rear-wheel-drive cars, a wiring harness on the rear subframe may be too short, which pulls on the connector until it loses contact. Recall 24V836 replaces the harness.
issues.next: If drive power cuts out, turn on your hazard lights, coast to a safe place and stop. Check your VIN for open recalls on the Lucid or NHTSA site and make sure the car has the latest software.

issues.t: Rear drive inverter can fail, cutting drive power (recall)
issues.sym: The car may lose drive power, possibly without warning.
issues.why: The Gen 4 inverter on rear-wheel-drive Airs can be damaged by internal friction. Recall 26V309 adds software that keeps checking for inverter failure, and Lucid replaces the inverter for free if it finds one.
issues.next: If drive power cuts out, turn on your hazard lights, coast to a safe place and stop. Check your VIN for open recalls on the Lucid or NHTSA site and make sure the car has the latest software.

issues.t: Rear half-shaft bolts may be loose (recall)
issues.sym: You may hear clunking or feel vibration from the rear, or the car may suddenly lose drive.
issues.why: On Pure rear-wheel-drive cars, the bolts holding a half-shaft (the axle that drives a wheel) to the drive unit may not have been tightened properly, so the shaft can come apart. Recall 25V669 has Lucid inspect the shaft and fit new bolts.
issues.next: If you hear a new clunk or feel a vibration from the rear, stop driving and arrange a tow. Check your VIN for this recall.

issues.t: Exterior lighting circuits can overheat, fire risk (recall)
issues.sym: Smoke or a hot smell near the headlights or the center brake light, or front lights or brake lights that stop working.
issues.why: The low-voltage exterior lighting circuits do not have enough overcurrent protection. Lucid has found three fires involving front lighting parts and four cases of smoke from the high-mounted brake light circuit. Recall 26V540 covers more than 27,000 Airs and is fixed by software.
issues.next: If it happens while you're driving: if you smell burning or see smoke, pull over where it's safe, turn the engine off, get everyone out and well away from the car, and call 911 if there are flames. Don't drive it again until it has been repaired. Install the recall software as soon as it is offered. Until your car is updated, park it outside and away from buildings.

issues.t: Windshield defroster stops working (recall)
issues.sym: The windshield does not clear in cold or damp weather because the heater blows cold air.
issues.why: The high-voltage coolant heater that warms the cabin can fail. Recalls 24V011 and 24V495 add a software warning when the heater fails, and Lucid replaces failed heaters for free.
issues.next: Do not drive if you cannot see out of the windshield. Check your VIN for these recalls and contact Lucid if the heater stops working.

issues.t: Rearview camera image blank or delayed (recall)
issues.sym: When you shift into reverse, the camera screen stays blank, shows a delayed image, or says "Camera Error. Turn your vehicle off and on again."
issues.why: Several software versions can stop the camera image from reaching the screen, for example when the car wakes from sleep. Lucid has fixed this with over-the-air updates under recalls 23V520, 25V670 and 26V017.
issues.next: Back up slowly using your mirrors and a look over your shoulder. Install the latest software update, and contact Lucid if the camera still fails.

issues.t: Front strut snap ring can fail, dropping ride height (recall)
issues.sym: The front of the car suddenly sits lower, or you hear a bang from the front suspension. A brake warning is possible.
issues.why: A snap ring under the front strut damper can fail, letting the car drop and possibly damaging a front brake line. Recall 22V090 has dealers inspect and replace the dampers.
issues.next: If the car suddenly sits low or brakes feel wrong, stop and have it towed. Check your VIN for this recall.

issues.t: Driver display screens go dark from a loose harness (recall)
issues.sym: The driver display screens go blank while driving, so speed and warnings may not show.
issues.why: The wiring harness for the display may not have been secured and can be damaged by the steering shaft. Recall 22V351 has Lucid inspect and secure it.
issues.next: If the screens go dark, pull over safely. Check your VIN for this recall.

issues.t: Front tow eye can pull loose when towing (recall)
issues.sym: The front tow hook can break away while the car is being pulled onto a truck.
issues.why: The tow eye bracket may not have been attached firmly to the front subframe. Recall 22V727 adds rivets where needed.
issues.next: Tell any tow driver to avoid the tow eye until the recall is done, and check your VIN.

issues.t: Windshield wipers can loosen and stop working (recall)
issues.sym: The wipers move but do not clear the glass, or one arm flops loose.
issues.why: The nuts that hold the wiper arms can loosen. Recall 23V521 tightens them and replaces damaged parts.
issues.next: If the wipers stop clearing in rain, slow down and pull over safely. Check your VIN for this recall.

issues.t: Rear seat heaters can overheat (recall)
issues.sym: A rear seat gets much hotter than expected, or there is a hot smell from the back seat.
issues.why: The software that watches the rear seat heater temperature can stop working. Recall 23V708 is an over-the-air fix.
issues.next: Turn the rear seat heaters off until the update is installed, and check your VIN.

issues.t: Phone key or door handles fail to unlock or open doors
issues.sym: The car does not unlock when you walk up with your phone, door handles shake or do not present, or a rear door will not open even though the car is unlocked.
issues.why: Owners on forums say phone-as-key unlocking is the most common complaint, and some of it is setup error. Other cases come from software bugs or door hardware faults.
issues.next: Carry the key card as a backup and confirm the phone key is set up in the Lucid app. If doors keep failing to open, contact Lucid service.

issues.t: Screens, CarPlay or navigation glitch with error messages
issues.sym: Apple CarPlay drops, audio cuts out, navigation or the radio stops working, phone connection is lost, and error messages show up on many drives. Owners often need to restart the system.
issues.why: These are software and control-unit problems. One owner's problems only ended after Lucid replaced the main control unit and related wiring.
issues.next: Keep the car's software up to date and note each error with the date. If problems persist, ask Lucid service to look at the control unit while you are under warranty.

issues.t: Sensor or LiDAR error warning in rain
issues.sym: A warning about the LiDAR or driver-assist sensors pops up in rain, and some assist features may pause.
issues.why: Rain or road spray blocks the sensor's view. Owners say it is common and usually clears quickly.
issues.next: Keep the sensors clean. If the warning stays on in dry weather, have it checked.

issues.t: Car switches from Hold to Roll mode on its own
issues.sym: The car creeps forward at a stop instead of holding still, because the stop setting changed by itself.
issues.why: Owners report the Hold/Roll setting changing without input, which points to a software bug.
issues.next: Check the setting before you drive and keep your foot ready on the brake. Report it to Lucid so it is logged.

issues.t: Rear climate blows hot on one side and cold on the other
issues.sym: Rear passengers feel cold air from one vent and hot air from another.
issues.why: An owner traced it to a climate control fault that appears to be software related.
issues.next: Report it to Lucid service with the date and settings used.

issues.t: Power trunk or front trunk acts up
issues.sym: The trunk or frunk will not open or close properly, or opens unexpectedly.
issues.why: Owners report odd trunk and frunk behavior, and one 2024 Air needed two frunk repairs in nine months.
issues.next: Make sure the trunk is fully closed before driving and have Lucid look at it under warranty.
